families.description: Marlow Hostel: a bunk-booking desk application with its own HTTP API, SQLite store, UI and independent oracle, distinct from every earlier reference family and never used in development. It deliberately shares the workflow skeleton of the earlier families so rounds stay comparable; vocabulary, markup, selectors, layout and mutants are new.
